items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: A merged PR of this run releases the Stop guard; contract and hooks doc updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: gh missing, timeout, non-zero exit and garbage output all return no PRs, so the guard keeps blocking; the 120 s recheck window is stamped even on failure.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: gh runs without a shell, argv list only; the branch name comes from the run pointer.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Parametrized states incl. reused-branch old merge, OPEN sibling, CLOSED, empty; blocker race; failure modes; env switch; tests are hermetic via the env switch.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: At most one gh call (8 s cap) per 2 minutes, only on a would-be block.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: lib 250 lines, delivered tests in their own 107-line file.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: New consumer of gh JSON state,mergedAt and the pointer's created_at; both parsed defensively.
